accepted.quote: H.R. 8884 fails to add sufficient guardrails that could address concerns about what the Trump Administration might do with such broad authority, given its track record of repeated attempts at sweeping benefit cuts.
accepted.bill: H.R. 8884, the Removing Barriers to Work for Disabled Americans Act
accepted.rationale: Neal criticizes the bill for lacking protections against benefit cuts, indicating support for protecting SSDI benefits.
